title: Elephant reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- elephant body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='62' rx='28' ry='24' fill='#8fa8c8'/>
  <!-- elephant head -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='20' fill='#9bb8d9'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='36' rx='14' ry='18' fill='#7d97b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='36' rx='14' ry='18' fill='#7d97b8'/>
  <!-- inner ears -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='36' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#c5a8c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='36' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#c5a8c8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='34' r='4' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='34' r='4' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='33' r='1.5' fill='#f5f5ff'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='33' r='1.5' fill='#f5f5ff'/>
  <!-- trunk curling toward book -->
  <path d='M45 46 Q45 58 38 62 Q32 66 35 56' stroke='#9bb8d9' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='80' width='10' height='14' rx='4' fill='#7d97b8'/>
  <rect x='52' y='80' width='10' height='14' rx='4' fill='#7d97b8'/>
  <!-- tusks -->
  <path d='M33 44 Q30 50 33 54' stroke='#f0e6c0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M57 44 Q60 50 57 54' stroke='#f0e6c0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <g transform='rotate(-8, 62, 70)'>
    <rect x='50' y='62' width='26' height='20' rx='2' fill='#e85555'/>
    <rect x='50' y='62' width='4' height='20' fill='#b83a3a'/>
    <rect x='56' y='65' width='17' height='14' rx='1' fill='#fff4e0'/>
    <line x1='59' y1='68' x2='70' y2='68' stroke='#c8a882' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='59' y1='71' x2='70' y2='71' stroke='#c8a882' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='59' y1='74' x2='67' y2='74' stroke='#c8a882' stroke-width='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- small heart above -->
  <path d='M72 20 Q74 16 78 16 Q82 16 82 20 Q82 24 78 28 Q74 24 72 20 Z' fill='#ff88aa'/>
</svg>
